💡 Boron-doped bismuth anodes are introduced to overcome bismuth's severe volume expansion and sluggish kinetics in magnesium-ion batteries. This interface-engineering strategy advances high-rate alloy anode design for magnesium-ion batteries.

item.title: Bulky Molecules Tailor Solvent Packing Fraction of Electrolytes for High‐Voltage Sodium‐Ion Battery
item.description:
حلال حجیم با محدودکردن چیدمان حلال، تشکیل جفت‌یون‌های تماسی و اینترفاز غنی از مواد معدنی را در باتری سدیم‌یون ولتاژ بالا تقویت می‌کند.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work reveals that bulky solvent molecules restrict solvent packing around Na+, quantified by fractal dimension, promoting anion-rich ion clusters and inorganic interphases. This suppresses electrolyte oxidation, enabling stable high-voltage sodium-ion batteries with 1407-cycle longevity and practical pouch cells exceeding 115 Wh kg−1, offering a molecular design principle for high-energy SIBs.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · electrolyte solvation · solvent packing · high-voltage · interphase

item.title: Hydrocarbothermal Reduction Co‐Upcycling of Spent Lithium‐Ion Batteries via Waste Plastics for Enabling Efficient Water Purification and Lithium Resource Recovery
item.description:
احیای هیدروکربوترمال با پلی‌اتیلن، باتری‌های لیتیوم-یونی مستعمل و پلاستیک‌ها را هم‌زمان بازیافت کرده و به تصفیه آب و بازیابی لیتیوم می‌پردازد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers co-upcycling of spent LiNi₀.₆Co₀.₂Mn₀.₂O₂ cathodes and waste polyethylene via hydrocarbothermal reduction, using plastics as both carbon source and reductant. It yields a NiCoMn/C catalyst enabling efficient peroxymonosulfate activation for water purification (0.411 min⁻¹) plus 87% lithium recovery, establishing a closed-loop paradigm integrating mixed-waste upcycling, environmental remediation, and resource recovery with economic and emissions benefits.
🏷 spent lithium-ion batteries · waste plastics · hydrocarbothermal reduction · lithium recovery · water purification
